statement: For the scalar FixedBook mathematical shadow: quotient floors and a caller-supplied selected mask decompose into floor sum plus selection count and have per-fill bounds under a positive-remainder premise; the max-volume/min-imbalance/highest-index rule has a unique winner on every nonempty bounded grid; accepted buy/sell equality premises imply the whole fill vector partitions to twice matched; a canonical zero-suffix premise implies full-fold equals active-prefix fold.

mutations.edit: one selected entry receives two atoms instead of one
the scan tests the previous winner against the challenger but still selects the challenger
each side fold includes entries from both sides
canonical padding admits nonnegative rather than zero suffixes

known_unclosed_boundaries: the production Rust body is digest-pinned and manually mapped, not imported into Verus
the dust loop's existence/progress and completed selection count are not proved; positive remainder of caller-selected entries is a theorem premise
unbounded mathematical integers are mapped manually to checked u64 totals and widened u128 products
score construction and the production choose_tick loop are not refined instruction-by-instruction
canonical zero suffix is a theorem premise, not a theorem about production validation; inactive scalar Order fields other than canonical_order_id are not required to be zero
relation_v1, relation_v1_stream, pairing, portfolio, AON, Solana/SBF, serialization, accounts, and deployment are excluded
